scenes.text: Every night she counted the tiles in her hallway before bed. Eight.
scenes.art_prompt: a dim apartment hallway at night, warm lamp light, anime horror

scenes.text: On Tuesday there were nine. On Wednesday, ten. The doors at each end had not moved.
scenes.art_prompt: a long hallway with tiled floor receding into shadow, anime horror

scenes.text: She laid a tape measure along the floor and marked the wall in pencil.
scenes.art_prompt: a tape measure and pencil mark on a wall, dim light, anime horror

scenes.text: The hallway had never changed. Her reflection at the far end was standing one tile closer each night.
scenes.art_prompt: a corridor with a faint reflection at the far end, anime horror

scenes.text:
She stopped counting.
The hallway had been counting her.
scenes.art_prompt: an empty hallway at dawn, one cold lamp, quiet and final, anime horror

scenes.text: Follow Quiet Horror Files for the next case.
scenes.art_prompt: a closed door at the end of a dark hallway, calm and final, anime horror
